narr: A thunderstorm produced locally heavy rain, in a short period of time, over an urban area prone to flash flooding.
ev: USGS stream gage, located on the Rocky Branch Creek at the intersection of Whaley St and Main St in Columbia, recorded a peak level of 10.11 feet at 1737 EDT (1637 EST). The flood stage is 7.2 feet. Photos on social media showed an inundated vehicle.
lsr: ROADWAY FLOODED AT THE INTERSECTION OF WHALEY STREET AND MAIN STREET. USGS WEBCAM SHOWS A FORD MUSTANG WAS SWEPT OFF THE ROADWAY BY FLOODWATERS AT 5:25 PM. THE STREAM GAGE REGISTERED 7.57 FEET AT 5:1
